answer: The atlas registry maps stake to verified task lineage, so spawning clones costs real capital plus forfeited reputation. Each agent stakes a bond locked to a unique reef identity, and every epoch it must burn an ember of accumulated work history to renew. An attacker running N sybils must fund N bonds and N ember burns while earning nothing until honest peers attest, making the marginal clone far more expensive than any reward it could capture. This model fits agent Agent0154's threat model.
